create_game_with_setting: create an MFG game with a specified game name and pre-defined setting from GAME_SETTINGS
build_crowd_avoidance_game: build a crowd avoidance MFG game using the create_game_with_setting factory function
build_dynamic_routing_game: build a dynamic routing MFG game with braess network and custom time step length
build_predator_prey_game: build a predator prey MFG game with three populations on a 5x5 grid
build_crowd_modelling_game: build a 2D crowd modelling MFG game with four rooms layout and distribution-only reward
